messages:
meera: Heads-up — saw a spike in 'stream:stalled' traces on the console for eu-west yesterday around 02:10 UTC. Clients display reconnects every ~3s and we got double token charges for a subset. Anyone else see this?

josh: yup saw the alert. looks correlated with the feature flag flip for session_grace = 0 -> 1s. rolling back now.

sam: that flag change was intended to reduce sticky lease wait but might be triggering probe-resume race. logs show a 204 from proxy then client re-subscribes quickly.

niranjan: can you paste the proxy logs? wondering if we mis-handle FIN vs early-close.

meera: snippet from proxy around the window: ```
[02:10:12] proxy: upstream 10.2.1.4 -> client: keepalive timeout, sent FIN
[02:10:12] proxy: route:stream-id=abc123 status=204 resume_token=xyz
[02:10:12] client: reconnect attempt 1 backoff=0.3s
[02:10:13] billing: charge token=tok_zzz route=streaming eu-west
```

josh: looks like the client treats 204 as transient and immediately reconnects; because session_grace went down, backend GC'd KV cache or tombstoned session causing new session creation + billing. double-charge path.

meera: infra-bot: can you confirm if any quota debits doubled in that time window?

infra-bot: [automated] Detected 2.1x increase in streaming session creates for route "chat-stream-v2" from 02:08 to 02:15 UTC. No other routes affected.

sam: ok, quick mitigation options: 1) revert session_grace to previous value (safe), 2) change client-side 204 handling to exponential backoff + jitter, 3) console-side: surface 'rapid reconnect' heatmap per route so SREs can triage.

niranjan: we already started rollback 5m ago per josh. Ops: revert done?

josh: rollback completed at 02:20 UTC. metrics trending back down.

meera: follow-ups: - add a small server-side debounce on interpreting 204 as terminal (200ms window) - add console telemetry: per-route reconnect-rate, per-user reconnect histogram, and a flag annotation for rollout changes that touch session semantics.

sam: agreed. can we put a lightweight server guard: if session_grace < 500ms, ignore immediate resume and mark for grace window? implement behind feature flag?

niranjan: prefer a fix that doesn't rely on client change — many partners won't update quickly. Server guard behind an opt-in config for Dedicated/private customers?

meera: also need a console UX tweak: when a flag flip occurs, annotate the topology view with the change and link to rollout. SREs kept pinging product asking "what changed" during the incident.

josh: +1 on annotation. Console-bot: can we auto-link recent feature flag flips to any sudden metric deltas?

console-bot: [automated] Idea captured: link feature flag toggles to metric deltas as an optional inspect overlay. Filed as PROD-4123.

sam: i'm going to open a tiny PR for the server debounce and an integration test that simulates 204->immediate reconnect loop. will tag meera for review.

meera: thanks. also create an alert: firing when reconnect-rate > baseline * 2 AND feature-flag-churn within last 10m. That would've reduced MTTD here.

josh: devex FYI — we should update quickstart note about 204 semantics for clients and recommend backoff. small blurb in streaming docs.

sam: PR #8745 created: server:stream-debounce + test. description: "debounce treating 204 as terminal for 250ms when session_grace < 1s to prevent rapid re-create storm".

meera: nice. moving to post-incident review: owner meera, sam; actions: 1) server debounce merged and rolled (sam) 2) console annotations + alert (josh) 3) docs update (devex) 4) run simulation to verify billing dedupe (niranjan). I'll set up a 30m blameless postmortem. :calendar:

josh: thanks all. small ask: add a console chart for 'session create latency' — might highlight when backend is GC'ing too fast.

meera: added to the ticket PROD-4123. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
